item.title: SEC proposes Regulation Crypto Assets with a $75M fundraising cap and a safe harbor allowing tokens to exit securities classification.
U.S. market structure bill faces pivotal Senate procedural vote on September 15, with stablecoin rewards provision still unresolved.
UK FCA opens cryptoasset authorisation application gateway on September 30, with full regulatory regime effective October 2027.
OCC misses GENIUS Act deadline for final stablecoin rules, now targeting November 2026 for publication.
EU national MiCA grandfathering arrangements expired July 1; crypto firms without authorisation must now cease EU service provision.
SEC and CFTC publish joint token taxonomy distinguishing digital commodities, digital tools, stablecoins, and digital securities.
SEC grants DTCC no-action relief to tokenize U.S. Treasuries, ETFs, and Russell 1000 equities starting late 2026.
OCC conditionally approves Circle, Ripple, Fidelity Digital Assets, and Paxos for national trust bank charters covering digital-asset custody.
JPMorgan's Kinexys platform lets institutional clients pledge Bitcoin and Ether as collateral for U.S. dollar loans.
Open Standard launches Open USD stablecoin with 140-plus founding partners including Stripe, Mastercard, Visa, and BlackRock.
Citigroup announces plans to launch institutional Bitcoin custody services integrated with its traditional asset management infrastructure.
Bitcoin spot ETF cumulative net inflows reach $53.9 billion, with total net assets rising to $83.3 billion.
Coldcard hardware wallet vulnerability exploited for over $130 million in Bitcoin losses across at least 12 separate attacks.
Attackers drain $295 million from Drift Protocol in the largest single crypto exploit of the first half of 2026.
Coinsbuy exchange loses $8 million in a cross-chain attack, contributing to July's $247 million in total industry theft losses.
